import std.measurements

// Structural unknown-state payloads only: no affine uncertainty propagation.
fn point(value: Float) -> Measurement<TemperaturePoint> {
    Measurement<TemperaturePoint> {
        value: temperature_point(value, "degC"),
        sources: [],
        known: false,
        reason: "sensor " + value.to_string()
    }
}

fn forward(value: Measurement<TemperaturePoint>) -> Measurement<TemperaturePoint> { value }

fn choose(flag: Bool, left: Measurement<TemperaturePoint>, right: Measurement<TemperaturePoint>) -> Measurement<TemperaturePoint> {
    if flag { left } else { right }
}

fn main() -> Void {
    first = point(20.0)
    alternate = point(30.0)
    mut current = choose(true, forward(first), alternate)
    print(current.value)
    print(choose(false, first, alternate).value)
    mut i = 0.0
    while i < 3.0 {
        current = point(40.0 + i)
        i = i + 1.0
    }
    print(current.value)
    print(current.reason)
    print(first.value)
    print(first.reason)
    drop(current)
    drop(first)
    drop(alternate)
}
